after: Asteroids_V5
At most 3 bullets may exist simultaneously. If 3 bullets are already active, pressing Space does not create another bullet and does not start or restart the firing cooldown.
At most 3 bullets may exist simultaneously.

before: Only subsequently spawned asteroids appear from the edges of the gameplay area. Asteroids do not split and do not actively chase the spaceship.
after: Only subsequently spawned asteroids appear from the edges of the gameplay area.
Asteroids do not split and do not actively chase the spaceship.

before: A bullet that reaches the end of its 1.5-second lifetime disappears without changing the score.
after: At most 3 bullets may exist simultaneously.
A bullet that reaches the end of its 1.5-second lifetime disappears without changing the score and immediately frees one bullet slot.
A bullet that hits an asteroid also disappears immediately and frees one bullet slot.

before: Score does not increase because of survival time, asteroid wrapping, or bullet expiration. The game does not record a separate high score.
after: Score does not increase because of survival time, asteroid wrapping, or bullet expiration.
The game does not record a separate high score.

before: Space is used to fire. A shot succeeds only when the 0.25-second firing cooldown has ended.
after: Space is used to fire. A shot succeeds only when:
1. The 0.25-second firing cooldown has ended.
2. Fewer than 3 bullets currently exist.
If 3 bullets already exist, pressing Space does not spawn a bullet and does not start or restart the firing cooldown.
At most 3 bullets may exist simultaneously.
A new bullet may be created only when fewer than 3 bullets are active and the firing cooldown has ended.
If 3 bullets are active, a Space input is ignored and does not start or restart the firing cooldown.

before: When a bullet reaches the end of its 1.5-second lifetime, it is removed without changing the score.
after: When a bullet reaches the end of its 1.5-second lifetime, it is removed without changing the score. When a bullet hits an asteroid, it is also removed. In either case, its removal immediately reduces the active bullet count and makes that bullet slot available again.
- The active bullet count decreases by 1.

before: While `playing`, the game continuously processes player rotation, forward movement, and shooting input. It updates spaceship, bullet, and asteroid positions, applies four-edge wrapping, advances bullet lifetimes and timers, and performs the 1.5-second asteroid-count check.
after: While `playing`, the game continuously processes player rotation, forward movement, and shooting input. A valid shot requires both an available firing cooldown and fewer than 3 active bullets.

The game updates spaceship, bullet, and asteroid positions, applies four-edge wrapping, advances bullet lifetimes and timers, removes expired bullets, and performs the 1.5-second asteroid-count check.
Removing a bullet because of expiration or asteroid collision immediately frees one bullet slot.
- Maximum active bullet count: 3

before: Successful shooting creates one bullet at the front of the spaceship. A bullet disappears when it hits an asteroid or reaches its 1.5-second lifetime.
after: Successful shooting creates one bullet at the front of the spaceship only when fewer than 3 bullets are currently active and the firing cooldown has ended.
A bullet disappears when it hits an asteroid or reaches its 1.5-second lifetime. Its disappearance makes one bullet slot available again.
